writeup: TIC 342600336 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.7555 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing the star to dim by 2.96 percent, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 170.2 using the Box Least Squares method. Pixel-level analysis confirms the eclipse signature at the target location, though with a centroid offset of 1.6 arcsec and a peak signal-to-noise of 11.2. No secondary eclipse has been detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unlisted object. The automated screening model assigned it a score of 0.39 on its likelihood scale. All data quality checks passed without flags, indicating clean photometry suitable for this candidate.
